Short Description: Sea-Bird Scientific Conductivity, Temperature, Depth (CTD) Profilers and Auxiliary Sensors are used to measure ocean water quality. Maintenance of current equipment and purchases of new equipment are crucial to collect this data and continue the work of the Harmful Algal Bloom group. These instruments must be regularly maintained due to their use in a salt water environment. Quantity: Three (3) years upon issuance of purchase order. Requestor: Matthew Garrett Fish and Wildlife Research Institute Ecosystem Assessment and Restoration, Harmful Algal Bloom ______________________________________________________________________________ Requirements: This request is to ensure future equipment purchases and proper calibration, maintenance, and repair of our Sea-bird Scientific profilers and sensors. The purchase of new equipment and service and maintenance of our four Conductivity, Temperature, and Depth Profilers and Auxiliary Sensors is required for continuation of work for the Harmful Alge Bloom group. Intended Single Source: Sea-Bird Scientific Amount: up to $150,000 Justification: Sea-Bird Scientific is the sole manufacturer and supplier of Sea-Bird products, and they are the only authorized facility equipped to perform service and calibration of Sea-Bird instruments. They recommend recalibrating Conductivity, Temperature, and Depth Profilers and sensors once per year at Sea-Bird's facilities. Sea-Bird maintains state-of-the-art equipment, thorough processes, and appropriate procedures to provide the most accurate calibrations of Sea-Bird instruments. We have four Sea-Bird Conductivity, Temperature, and Depth Profilers equipped with Sea-Bird auxiliary sensors that are crucial to further water quality research in the Harmful Algal Blooms group. We have also procured a Submersible Underwater Nutrient Analyzer (SUNA) sensor and may procure more, and Sea-Bird are the only providers of that sensor. The SUNA is already integrated on West Florida Shelf moorings, glider deployments, and more. Further, all Sea-Bird profiling CTDs come equipped with “Voltage Channels” that can accept and analog voltage signal within 0-5 V, and the SUNA is configured to output analog data to allow for critical real-time profiling applications, so having a SUNA and compatible Sea-Bird profiling system is also necessary. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) Title: The Esri Enterprise Agreement Agency number: DOT-SS-26-9004-JM Commodity codes: 81111805 Proprietary or licensed systems maintenance or support; 81112200 Software maintenance and support Posting:

NOTICE OF SINGLE SOURCE procurement for the Florida Department of Transportation:

 

The Department of Transportation, Office of Information Systems, is requesting information from prospective vendors regarding their ability to supply the services described in the attached document.

 

KNOWN VENDOR: Environmental Systems Research Institute, Inc.

 

Vendor information must be received by 5:00 p.m. (EST) on Tuesday, August 19, 2025, at either the e-mail or mailing address listed in this posting.

 

If it is determined in writing by the Department, after reviewing any information received from prospective vendors, that the commodities or contractual services are available only from a single source, the Department will post notice of its intended decision to enter into a single source purchase contract on the Vendor Information Portal, in the manner specified in s. 120.57(3), Florida Statutes.

Short Description: Bundled packaging for licensing software, maintenance and online services for the Department. Commodity: 81111805: Proprietary or licensed systems maintenance or support 81112200: Software maintenance and support Quantity: 10/01/2025 - 10/10/2026 Requestor: Daniel Teaf Requirements: The Geographic Information System or Geographical Information System (GIS) is a system designed to capture, store, manipulate, analyze, manage, and present all types of spatial or geographical data. The Department currently utilizes Environmental Systems Research Institute (Esri) software, which is required to support all enterprise applications with a GIS Component, as well as to support the District offices in terms of GIS development. GIS supports the Department’s emergency response activities within the Emergency Management Office, operation activities with the eMaintenance initiative within the Office of Maintenance, communication, awareness, collaboration, monitoring, and reporting activities with Safety Data Integration Space within the State Safety Office, Special Edition Sourcebook and Mobility Data Integration Space within Forecasting and Trends Office, Traffic Engineering and Operations Data Integration Space within Traffic Operations Office. Intended Source: Environmental Systems Research Institute, Inc. Amount: $875,000.00 Justification: Esri, as owner and manufacturer, is the sole source provider of all U.S. domestic Enterprise Agreements (EA). While some products are available through value-added resellers on a unit priced basis, Esri is the only source that can grant a right to copy and deploy products in an EA. An EA is a bundled package for licensing software, maintenance, and online services for redistribution within the organization. Esri products are provided with a special grant to copy and deploy specified quantities of capped items and unlimited quantities of items without a cap, during the term of the EA.

matters.text:

This description of commodities or contractual services intended for purchase from a single source is posted in accordance with Section 287.057(5) ©, Florida Statutes and will remain posted for a period of at least 15 business days.

 

The Department of Transportation intends to enter into a single source contract with Florida Level & Transit Co., Inc. for Statewide Software and equipment customer care packages.

Short Description: Equipment, Maintenance and Support for various surveying hardware and software in support of the Department's Surveying and Mapping efforts and the Florida Permanent Reference Network (FPRN) Commodity: 811112200: Software maintenance and support Quantity: One (1) year Requestor: Ronald Hanson, Office of Surveying & Mapping Requirements: During and immediately following natural disasters, the Florida Permanent Reference Network (FPRN) provides Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) corrections to disaster response teams for emergency responses, disaster mapping and assessment, and infrastructure monitoring. The Department Survey and Mapping personnel provide GNSS carrier phase and code range measurements in support of 3-dimensional positioning activities for work programs throughout the State, using FPRN. The existing GNSS antennas used to collect this information at the individual sites are reaching end of life. Upgrading these units will allow for the FPRN to track additional frequencies broadcast by the GNSS satellites. This increased amount of data is critical to meet the Department's business model and to meet the Department's obligations to state and federal regulations. Leica's Customer Care Packages (CCPs) are used to keep the Department's Leica surveying software and equipment updated with the current software and firmware versions available and will allow for future upgrades in support of the Department's Surveying and Mapping efforts and the FPRN. The CCPs also allow the manufacturer to provide customer support for software and equipment if an issue arises that the Department is not able to solve in-house. The hardware includes controllers, an iCON tablet, Total Stations, 3D Laser Scanners, digital levels, GNSS base station receivers and GNSS rovers. The software also includes all Surveying and Intended Source: Florida Level & Transit Co., Inc. Amount: $366,037.65 Justification: Leica has a vendor agreement with their vendors Nationwide. Florida Level & Transit Co., Inc. is the only known authorized distributor for the State of Florida.

In addition, the fire suppression system is required for patrolling fire lines within hydric mitigation sites, for mopping up after prescribed burns and initial attack in the event of a wildfire.

District mitigation sites require a low ground pressure amphibious mowing unit to minimize soil disturbance and site degradation which are critical factors for ground cover restoration. Short Description: TS16 Total Station with CCP (Customer Care Packages) and accessories, 360 Degree Prism and Pole GS18T, CS20 LTE Disto Controller with accessories and Tripod for TS16 and GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) Poles. Commodity: 41114200 - Land surveying instruments Quantity: One (1) Year Requestor: Ronald Hanson, Office of Surveying and Mapping Requirements: The FDOT Surveying and Mapping personnel provide GNSS carrier phase and code range measurements in support of 3- dimensional positioning activities for work programs throughout the State, using the Florida Permanent Reference Network (FPRN). The existing GNSS antennas used to collect this information do not support tilt compensation or all the constellations supported by the FPRN. Additionally, the existing tripods used to collect this information allow for setup error. Replacing the existing GS15 antennas with GS18T antennas will allow State Survey Personnel to take advantage of the new tilt compensation technology and the new satellite broadcasts offered through the FPRN. Without the purchase of the GS18T survey personnel will not be able to take advantage of the extra satellites that the newer constellations provide. Replacing the existing tripods with fixed-height tripods will eliminate setup errors. Also, replacing the existing CS20 controllers with upgraded CS20 controllers will allow cellular communications to once again be active. Without the replacement of the CS20 controllers, State Survey personnel will be required to use existing “hotspot” technology and will limit the types of GNSS antennas that can be used. Finally, the TS16 total station allows field personnel to perform surveying functions. Intended Source: Florida Level & Transit Co., Inc. Amount: $114,914.12 Justification: FLT Geosystems, based in Ft. Lauderdale, Florida, is the sole authorized distributor for Lecia Geosystems’ High-end Surveying segment consisting of GNSS, Robotic surveying instruments, related field and office software, firmware and CCP within the state of Florida

Addi-tionally, the existing tripods used to collect this information allow for setup error. Replacing the existing GS15 antennas with GS18T antennas will allow State Survey Personnel to take advantage of the new tilt compensation technology and the new satellite broadcasts offered through the FPRN. Without the purchase of the GS18T survey personnel will not be able to take advantage of the extra satellites that the newer constellations provide. Replacing the existing tripods with fixed-height tripods will eliminate setup errors. Also, replacing the existing CS20 controllers with upgraded CS20 controllers will allow cellular communications to once again be active. Without the replacement of the CS20 controllers, State Survey personnel will be required to use existing “hotspot” technology and will limit the types of GNSS antennas that can be used. Short Description: Modify and add the Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) workflow process documents. Commodity: 81112200: Software maintenance and support 43233700: System management software Quantity: Six (6) months Requestor: Donna Green, Office of Policy Planning Requirements: The Metropolitan Planning Organization's (MPO) Document Portal workflows will allow MPOs and Transportation Planning Organizations (TPO) to submit new versions of, amendments to, or modifications of Long Range Transportation Plans (LRTP), Transportion Improvement Plans (TIP), or Unified Project Work Programs (UPWP) documents for review by multiple agencies. These fields will ask the users to indicate if these documents are new document versions, modifications or amendments to existing approved documents. Based on their selection, these documents will be processed through specific workflows to coordinate courtesy or required reviews from the appropriate staff at the appropriate reviewing agency. These workflows are based on the four review processes used by the Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT): New TIPs or LRTPs, LRTP and TIP amendments and modifications, UPWP amendments and modifications, and new UPWPs. The MPO Document Portal is designed to help facilitate the reviews of the three major documents created by the MPOs which include LRTPs, TIPs, and UPWPs. AskReply, Inc., is the creator of the GAP system and is the only known vendor who can modify and update this system.

The Department of Transportation intends to enter into a single source contract with Mettler-Toledo. for Auto Titration System.

Short Description: Chloride Auto-titration system for testing chloride content in concrete and cementitious materials. Commodity: 41110000 - Measuring and Observing and Testing Instruments 41114600 - Metals and Metallurgy and Structural Materials Testing Instruments Quantity: Ten (10) Months Requestor: Melanie Sowers, State Materials Office Requirements: The Chloride Auto-titration system is a set of instruments used for testing chloride content in concrete and cementitious materials. The current system being used by FDOT cannot perform certain functions to support updates to the test method to comply with the Florida Method of Test, FM 5-516. Additionally, the current system is reaching the end of its service life. The new system has the functionality to perform all the tasks needed to carry out Florida Method of Test, FM 5-516 for determining low-levels of chloride in concrete and raw materials. The system has the capability to accommodate a sufficient number of 180 milliliter beakers to maximize efficiency and performance. In addition, the system has the built-in controls that allow the titrator to independently determine the proper solution strength to use for titration. This built-in logic allows for the system to run fully automatic so that testing can be performed after the laboratory employee has left for the day or allows them to perform other tasks during their normal work schedule. This will significantly increase the number of tests that can be performed and improve the accuracy and repeatability of the testing by removing the human variability associated with a manual testing method. Intended Source: Mettler-Toledo, LLC. Amount: $152,427.41 Justification: Mettler-Toledo is the only known vendor known that possess equipment with the functionality to perform all the tasks needed to carry out Florida Method of Test, FM 5-516.

Short Description: Submersible receivers, data telemetry transmitters, tags, proprietary or unique accessories and software, and any updated or improved versions of these, and repairs thereof. Quantity: 3 years upon issuance of purchase order Requestor: Luiz R. Barbieri, Ph.D., Section Leader Marine Fisheries Research Section FWC - Fish & Wildlife Research Institute Luiz.Barbieri@myfwc.com ______________________________________________________________________________ Requirements: 1) Submersible, single channel receiver capable of identifying VEMCO V7, V8, V9, V9TP, V9AP, V13, V16, HR2,VR2-AR, VR2AR-X, VR100-200, VMT and VPS, VR2TX, VR2C, VR2W, NexTrak R1 and VRAR coded transmitters and any required repairs and upgrades to these receivers. Short Description: Scalable advanced rail detection system that uses acoustic sensors to detect train presence, direction, speed, etc along at-grade rail crossings on arterials. Commodity: 46161500 Traffic Control, 80111614 - Temporary engineering services Quantity: 250 TRAINFO Sensors with accessories; 250 TRAINFO solar kits; 500 1-year extended warranty terms; 9,000 cellular data monthly terms; 500 hours of engineering and integration; 500 hours of system support; 36 software license monthly terms. Requestor: FDOT D2 - Traffic Operations - ITS - Adam Storm Requirements: To be used for highly accurate train detection with attributes like presence, speed, length, direction, etc. which will assist first responders to plan for alternative routes in case of blockage by train. The train presence data and predicted arrival time may be made available to all road users through FL511 app and other dissemination means. Intended Source: TRAINFO Corporation Amount: $4,360,000.00 Justification: As described above, the product must be able to provide real-time and historical train presence, direction, and speed data based on detection by traditional and innovative sensors. The market for such systems based on TERL-approved detection devices is very narrow and no other systems have been introduced to District Two with such accuracy. Using acoustic sensor solves the problem of false positives and false negatives that could exist with camera-based detections. District Two has been actively involved in the development of this solution to meet the Department's current and future needs. This solution has the potential to be a fully scalable and efficiently deployable system along interconnected arterials affected by at-grade rail operations.

Notice of intended single-source purchase, Florida Gaming Control Commission (FGCC) Title: Axon Enterprises, Inc. Agency number: None Commodity codes: 46182500 Personal safety devices or weapons Posting:

Section 16.711, Florida Statutes outlines the powers and duties of the Florida Gaming Control Commission's (FGCC) Division of Gaming Enforcement. This statute states that all Division of Gaming Enforcement Special Agents are certified law enforcement officers and have the power to detect, apprehend, and arrest for any alleged violation of chapter 24, part II of chapter 285, chapter 546, chapter 550, chapter 551, or chapter 849, or any rule adopted pursuant thereto, or any law of the State of Florida. These Special Agents may enter upon any premises at which gaming activities are taking place in the state for the performance of their lawful duties and may take with them any necessary equipment. 

The Axon Enterprise, Inc. TASER 10 Conducted Energy Weapon (CEW) is a multi-shot energy weapon with a detachable magazine holding 10, TASER 10 cartridges and has a range of 45 feet when deployed. This CEW provides a high-efficiency flashlight, a green LASER sight, weapons log, and a central information display that shows mission critical data such as remaining battery energy, burst time, and cartridge status. The TASER Weapons Docking System, which is included with this purchase, connects to the AXON Evidence.Com system, which the Florida Gaming Control Commission (FGCC) Division of Gaming Enforcement already utilizes for digital evidence management purposes. Additionally, the TASER Weapons Docking System provides onboard self-diagnostic and system status monitoring and r Short Description: Providing TASER 10 Conducted Energy Weapons, accessories, and software for use by certified law enforcement Special Agents assigned to the Division of Gaming Enforcement. Quantity: Advance Payment of Five (5) Year Service Term Requestor: Division of Gaming Enforcement Requirements: Section 16.711, Florida Statutes outlines the powers and duties of the Florida Gaming Control Commission's (FGCC) Division of Gaming Enforcement. This statute states that all Division of Gaming Enforcement Special Agents are certified law enforcement officers and have the power to detect, apprehend, and arrest for any alleged violation of chapter 24, part II of chapter 285, chapter 546, chapter 550, chapter 551, or chapter 849, or any rule adopted pursuant thereto, or any law of the State of Florida. These Special Agents may enter upon any premises at which gaming activities are taking place in the state for the performance of their lawful duties and may take with them any necessary equipment. ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: $117,992.22 Justification: Axon Enterprises, Inc. has proprietary rights to all TASER brand products and is the sole manufacturer, distributor, and retailer of all TASER brand products in the State of Florida. The TASER is considered the leader in conducted energy weapons (CEW) because of a combination of technology, reliability, safety, research and institutional adoption. The superior probe and electrical design of TASER cartridges and probes are engineered for optimal spread and angle for better neuromuscular incapacitation, barbed probes that stick through clothing, and precise pulse shaping that disrupts motor control without causing cardiac capture. Axon Enterprises, Inc. has invested in evidence-based safety research that has allowed TASER products to be approved by major police agencies and is used in courts as the standard reference for CEWs. The TASER is unique as it not only offers the CEW device, but the science, training, legal, defensibility, and reliability needed for law enforcement agencies that decided to deploy this type of weapons system. Equipment is needed for remote logging of hydrologic data to be telemetered to and accepted by Aquarius software for near real-time updates on field conditions. The XLink 500 logger provides multiple interfaces and protocols (HTTP, TCP/IP, FTP) for communication and three levels of security configuration. The SatLink 3 loggers transmit data using the GOES Satellite Network with an assigned and unique address. It is required that District data loggers can communicate using the LinkComm Software to be compatible with our current network. Both the XLink and SatLink units have sensor interfaces which allow connection to SDI-12, RS-232, USB host and device ports, and RS-485 devices which can be programmed using LinkComm software run on field laptop computers, tablets or cell phones. The data can be telemetered over the Verizon network with a removable SIM card or downloaded through Bluetooth connection while on site.

Short Description: Electronic counters. Automated vehicle and pedestrian counters for use at Wildlife Management Area entrances, trailheads, and other locations. Quantity: 10 each WAViX , 70 each ZELT Evi Car, 73 each Components #797, 2each ZELT Evo Cars -1 Loop - motorized vehicles - NoActivated - Total cost $ 349,330.00 Requestor: Division of Habitat and Species Conservation (HSC), Ashley Scruggs Public Access Service Office Business Manager Requirements: Electronic traffic counters provide valuable data on public use and visitation at Wildlife Management Area’s statewide. Currently, there are 200 traffic counters collecting data on area visitation at designated entrances and public use areas daily. EcoCounters utilize Bluetooth and remote wireless data transfer (versus RS232 serial cable requirements of the current solution). EcoCounters also do not have to be removed from the field installation for data transfer. EcoCounters are weather-resistant and do not require additional environmental housings and are ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: $349,330.00 Justification: This vendor exclusively produces vehicle and pedestrian counters and services meeting the required specifications needed for the collection of visitation data. Visitation data provides a temporal and spatial account of Wildlife Management Area visitation and has also been instrumental in other management and reporting such as visitation economic impacts and law enforcement investigations. FWC staff has done extensive research on counter options and EcoCounter is the only solution meeting all required specifications. FWC intends to deploy a combination of infrared pedestrian counters and inductive loop vehicle counters WMA system- wide, replacing the aging and sometimes unreliable or less robust counters currently used. Often, environmental conditions and severe weather events cause irreparable damage to the traffic counters, requiring that they be replaced and collection of data can be time-consuming and inefficient, as the current solution requires the counter to be uninstalled, docked at the office for data download, and then reinitialized and redeployed in the field. EcoCounters utilize Bluetooth and remote wireless data transfer (versus RS232 serial cable requirements of the current solution) which reduces the workload of field staff in collecting the data and reduces the workload and potential error sources for office staff in compiling and processing the acquired data. This also negates the need for separate counter docking stations, further minimizing sources of error

Short Description: Resurfacing of the Inertial Profiler Certification Track at the Williston Airport in Levy County Commodity: 30121600: Asphalts; 30121700: Road and railroad construction materials; 30111500: Concrete and mortars; 72141103: Highway and road paving service Quantity: Two Months Requestor: Melanie Sowers, State Mateials Office Requirements: The State Materials Office (SMO) has developed a resurfacing plan for the Inertial Profiler Certification Track located at Williston Airport in Williston, Florida. This project is necessary due to the deterioration of the existing pavement surfaces, which consists of an open-graded friction course (FC-5) and a dense-graded friction course (FC-12.5). The current condition of the track has reduced the ability to achieve consistent and repeatable measurements, thereby impacting the reliability of inertial profiler certification. To restore the integrity of the certification process and ensure compliance with AASHTO R56 requirements for inertial profiler certification, the existing FC-5 and FC-12.5 surfaces will be removed from the Certification Sections, Lead-in Section, and cul-de-sac. The Certification Sections will be resurfaced with both FC-5 and FC-12.5 to maintain continuity with established testing conditions. To improve durability and reduce long-term maintenance needs, the Lead-out Section and cul-de-sac will be resurfaced with FC-12.5. Additionally, the Lead-out Section will be extended to connect with an existing taxiway to enhance operational efficiency and provide a more consistent approach for testing. Intended Source: V. E. Whitehurst & Sons, Inc. Amount: $211,700.00 Justification: V.E. Whitehurst & Sons, Inc. is the original contractor for the test track. The asphalt mix designs used are proprietary to V. E. Whitehurst and are not transferable; thereby, ensuring material consistency and preserving the integrity of historical certification baselines.

Notice of intended single-source purchase, Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) Title: Leica Geosystems Photogrammetry Software Support and Maintenance Agency number: DOT-SS-26-9084-DG Commodity codes: 81112200 Software maintenance and support Posting:

This description of commodities or contractual services intended for purchase from a single source is posted in accordance with Section 287.057(5) ©, Florida Statutes and will remain posted for a period of at least 15 business days.

The Department of Transportation intends to enter into a single source contract with Leica GeoSystems, Inc., for Leica GeoSystems Software Support and Maintenance.

Short Description: Leica GeoSystems Software Maintenance Contract Commodity: 81112200 - Software maintenance and support Quantity: Three (3) Years. Requestor: Michael Maluda, Office of Surveying and Mapping. Requirements: Leica photogrammetric software includes applications for processing and analyzing aerial photography and point cloud data. It is critical to stay current with the Leica GeoSystems Inc. software maintenance and periodic upgrades to ensure the functionality of the software used by the Department’s Mobile Surveying & Mapping section to estimate, review, quality assurance, and quality control mobile surveying and mapping products and services in support of the Department’s Work Program, FDOT Districts, other state agencies, and the public. Intended Source: Leica GeoSystems, Inc. Amount: $75,000.00 Justification: Leica GeoSystems Inc. is the licensed distributor of this software and is the only known source available to provide the required software, training, support, and maintenance.

Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE) Title: DNA Testing Services, Evaluations & Research Agency number: FDLE-SS-2659 Commodity codes: 41105600 Deoxyribonucleic acid DNA sequencing products; 85121803 Biological laboratory services; 85131709 Genetics research services Posting:

THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR BID OR PROPOSAL. THIS IS STATUTORILY MANDATED FIFTEEN BUSINESS DAY ADVERTISEMENT OF AN INTENDED SINGLE SOURCE PROCUREMENT BY FDLE.

SEE ATTACHED DOCUMENTATION FOR DETAILS OF THE PRODUCTS AND SERVICES TO BE PROCURED AND SINGLE SOURCE JUSTIFICATION FOR THE SAME.

Short Description: DNA Testing Services, Evaluations & Research to identify persons using Forensic Investigative Genetic Genealogy. Quantity: 12 months Requestor: FDLE / Investigations and Forensic Science / Laboratories Requirements: Pursuant to s. 943.32 Florida Statute, the FDLE operates regional crime laboratories offering forensic services to Florida's law enforcement and medical examiner community. FDLE also operates a Forensic Investigative Genetic Genealogy program supported by an in-house Genetic Genealogy Investigations team. Services sought will support a continuation of existing projects involving evaluation of DNA extracts, DNA sequencing services, and genetic genealogy research support as part of FDLE's Missing and Unidentified Human Remains (MUHR) Program (presently BJA-funded) as well as some FDLE Forensic Investigative Genetic Genealogy ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: Rate Agreement Justification: The department seeks to employ testing services from Othram, Inc., to include Forensic Grade Genome Sequencing (FGGS™) and shotgun sequencing targeting 500K or more SNP markers, or WGS, for unknown samples. The FGGS™ technology is specific to Othram, Inc and its TX facility. Highly degraded, contaminated, bone samples and samples of extremely low quality and quantity DNA template are expected to constitute the bulk of the testing needs in this project. A suitable vendor must employ genomic refinement techniques, including but not be limited to: DNA repair, concentration, microbial DNA sequestration or elimination, other means of preparing DNA extracts well-suited for SNP sequencing. A quality control (QC) step must be integrated to assess whether or not the sample is amenable for further processing. This can be via real-time quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) or a proprietary suitability analysis. The Othram FGGS™ workflow affords the above as well as a practice of discontinuation of testing where available methods are not likely to yield usable SNP profile results, preserving the DNA from evidentiary materials for potential future advancements. FGGS™ satisfies this requirement as well as the specific need for incorporating a mechanism to detect low-level contamination, cross-contamination, sample switches, or workflow errors. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Health (DOH) Title: Information Technology Platform Solution Agency number: EXP2686 Commodity codes: 81112200 Software maintenance and support; 81112210 System management software maintenance Posting:

FDOH, Bureau of Epidemiology, has the need to purchase a modified solution for the current uploader process for the file transfer between the FPICN and ESSENCE-FL. The modified solution would replace older methodology with the NPDS Uploader approach that utilizes an XML file format upload method. Intended Source: Vac-Con/Southern Sewer Equipment Sales

The North Dade Maintenance section is requesting approval for the replacement and installation of a debris tank and repair of the vacuum relief system on a 2018 Vac-Con Vactor truck at a total cost of $92,155.00.

This Vactor truck is essential to North Dade’s daily maintenance operations and is routinely used to remove sediment and debris from drainage structures along the state roadway system. The unit plays a critical role in maintaining drainage capacity in flood-prone and low-lying areas, including Miami Beach, where keeping stormwater systems clear is vital to preventing roadway flooding during heavy rain events. Without a fully operational Vactor unit, the department’s ability to maintain drainage infrastructure and respond to restricted drains would be significantly impacted.

This description of commodities or contractual services intended for purchase from a single source Short Description: 2018 Vac Service debris tank replacement and repair of vacuum relief system Commodity: Replace and install new debris tank for 2018 vactor and repair of vacuum relief system. Quantity: One time purchase. Requestor: North Dade Autoshop Requirements: Please see attached specs. Intended Source: Sole Source - Vac-con/Southern Sewer Equipment Sales Amount: $92,155.00 Justification: The North Dade maintenance section is requesting approval for the replacement and installation of a debris tank and repair of the vacuum relief system on a 2018 Vac-Con Vactor truck at a total cost of $92,155.00. During a recent inspection conducted by Vac-Con, several areas on the top portion of the debris tank were found to have steel thickness measurements below 3.5 mm. Per manufacturer guidance, once the tank wall thickness falls below this threshold the structural integrity of the tank is considered compromised and the tank should be reinforced or replaced to ensure safe operation. The inspection also determined the vacuum relief valves on the unit are seized and no longer allow the system to properly relieve vacuum pressure, creating both an operational and safety concern. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE) Title: FL Regional Law Enforcement Information Exchange (LInX) system Maintenance and Technical Support Agency number: FDLE-SS-2703 Commodity codes: 81112200 Software maintenance and support Posting:

The FDLE’s Florida Regional LInX system, essential for law enforcement data sharing, was originally acquired through a competitive ITN from Northrop Grumman in 2015. This system integrates data from various sources, including RMS, JMS, CAD, pawn systems, and registries. On February 1, 2021, Peraton, Inc. acquired Northrop Grumman’s Federal IT and mission support services. Since then, Peraton has maintained uninterrupted service for our LInX system. FDLE is seeking to continue receiving these vital maintenance and support services through a single source procurement.

Peraton is the only entity authorized under federal contract N00189-22-D-Z036 to perform maintenance and support on the Law Enforcement Information Exchange (LInX) system. The proprietary software and systems administration tasks integral to LInX are exclusively managed by Peraton, ensuring compliance, security, and operational continuity. This includes exclusive responsibility for the Florida Regional LInX node, covering all aspects such as preventive maintenance, system administration, and proprietary software support. Given these circumstances, Peraton is the only vendor capable of fulfilling FDLE's needs for this system.

Notice of intended single-source purchase, Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) Title: Upgrade of the Locked Wheel Friction Trailer (LWFT) Agency number: DOT-SS-27-9016-CA Commodity codes: 25191800 Vehicle testing and measuring equipment; 41111600 Length and thickness and distance measuring instruments; 41111615 Laser measuring systems; 81101706 Laboratory equipment maintenance Posting:

Short Description: Equipment, Software, Maintenance and System Upgrade Commodity: 25191800: Vehicle testing and measuring equipment 41111600: Length and thickness and distance measuring instruments, 41111615: Laser measuring systems 81101706: Laboratory equipment maintenance Quantity: 10 Months (Delivery) Requestor: Melanie Sowers, State Materials Office Requirements: The Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) utilizes the Locked Wheel Friction Trailer (LWFT) as a specialized test vehicle to measure pavement surface skid resistance. The LWFT collects network and project level sliding friction force data. Acquisition of LWFT includes the equipment design, computer control systems, software, and hardware assemblies. The collection of existing roadway condition and geometry data is critical to design activities Districtwide and it is required for FDOT to be in compliance with the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) Pavement Design Guidelines. The current LWFT is beyond its service life and requires an upgrade to meet FDOT needs. The upgraded LWFT must be compatible with FDOT's currently owned units and must produce data in the same manner and format as the current units. The data processing and reduction software must be compatible with that currently used to upload data to maintain FDOT developed data processing and analysis software based on the ICC data acquisition system. Intended Source: International Cybernetics Company, LP (ICC) Amount: $245,495.00 Justification: ICC manufactures and is the sole vendor to rebuild, upgrade, repair, evaluate, and provide proprietary software updates for its equipment. ICC is the only vendor who can rebuild/upgrade the LWFT which includes proprietary items such as equipment design, computer control systems, software, and hardware components. ICC does not have resellers.

Short Description: Software Quantity: 12 months Requestor: William Willis - Chief of General Services Requirements: Omnigo Software, LLC will migrate the Florida Department of Education (FDOE) property inventory data from TraQ6 to TraQ7 and implement the upgrade to TraQ7 Asset Management solution. Omnigo will develop a new Android-based mobile application to replace the existing MC300 application, as the TraQ7 Quartermaster platform supports only modern Android-based mobile devices. The new application will provide equivalent functionality, enabling users to tag new assets, update existing asset records, perform inventory scans, and continue operating in offline mode when network connectivity is unavailable. Omnigo will also develop custom integration functionality to facilitate the import and export of asset data between TraQ7 and the PALM system. The TraQ Asset Management solution will be hosted within Omnigo’s cloud- hosting environment, as TraQ7 is available exclustively as a hosted solution. Omingo will provide Omnigo EverSure services, which include ongoing training, consulting, technical support, software maintenance, and product upgrades. Amount: $75,000.00 Justification: Omnigo Software, LLC is the sole owner, developer, and authorized provided of the Quartermaster asset management software, including the proprietary custom functionality developed specifically for the Florida Department of Education (FDOE). Since 2004, FDOE has utilized the Quartermaster system to support its property inventory management processes, including custom enhancement for PALM import/export integration and other Department-specific business requirements. As Department transitions from the legacy TraQ6 platform to TraQ7, Omnigo is the only authorized vendor and technically capable of providing the required custom development and ensuring compatibility with the Department’s existing Quartermaster environment and proprietary customizations. This includes development and support for the Android application, PALM integration, cloud-hosted services, software maintenance upgrades, technical support, consulting, and training. Omnigo is the sole owner and the custom functionality implemented for FDOE, no other vendor is authorized to provide these services. Omnigo Software, LLC is the only source capable of meeting the Department’s requirements for the TraQ7 migration and ongoing support. Short Description: Live-a-board vessel to support multi-day SCUBA-based marine research and monitoring activities conducted throughout the Florida Keys, Marquesas and Dry Tortugas regions. Market research was conducted in cooperation with the National Park Service to explore vendor options. This research confirmed that only one vendor is capable of meeting the minimum requirements mentioned above with CUA- authorization to operate in the Dry Tortugas. That vendor is the Makai, Inc. The Makai, Inc. is the only CUA-authorized vendor capable of meeting these minimum requirements by providing a vessel with sufficient capacity, overnight accommodations, and operational support. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR BIDS OR PROPOSALS. PLEASE DO NOT 

SUBMIT A BID OR “NO BID” REPLY. The Agency has reason to believe that 

the services or commodities described herein are only available from a 

single source. Any prospective vendors must provide information in writing 

regarding their ability to supply the commodities or contractual services 

described in the attached specifications. 

 

Vendor’s information regarding their ability to provide the product or 

service should be emailed to the contact person listed on this 

advertisement and must be received no later than September 08, 2026, and by 4:00 PM ET (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and state holidays). 

 

The Contractor/Vendor ultimately selected for this contract must warrant 

that it has the capability in all respects to fully perform the contract 

requirements and the integrity and reliability that will assure good-faith 

performance as a responsible vendor, and that the Contractor/Vendor shall 

comport with Chapter 287, F.S., and all other applicable rules and laws. 

Short Description: Procurement of a Marsh Master MM- 2MX-KD with Fire Package and Front Hitch; KC: Kohler Engine, Hi/Low Flow Pumps & Rear Hitch; Roller Chopper, MM-2MX Rotarty Cutter, and MM-2LX Vegetation Blade.TRLR XLG- L Extra Long Galvanized Tilt Deck Trailer with Electric Brakes and delivery to Milton, FL. The Marsh Master® is a tracked amphibious vehicle Quantity: One-time purchase upon execution of a purchase order. Requestor: Nathan Bunting, Biological Administrator I, Habitat and Species Conservation Requirements: FWC's Northeast Region manages over 40,350 acres of submerged or wetland habitats which are frequently inaccessible for resource management, which includes prescribed fire, hardwood removal, and invasive plant control. A tracked amphibious vehicle will allow improved access to areas where other equipment cannot reach, while limiting soil disturbance and habitat ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: $278,790.00 Justification: Marsh Master, supplied by Coast Machinery LLC is the only equipment found that meets our specified needs. The Marsh Master is a low ground pressure vehicle that will allow access to submerged or wetland habitats with minimum damage to natural resources and obviate equipment getting grounded or stuck in wet and loose soils. The onboard fire suppression package, mower, and chopper implement will be used in establishment of fire containment lines for prescribed burning, wildfire suppression, and general support of prescribed fire operations in difficult to manage wetland environments, including floodplain, basin marshes, salt marshes, and shrup bog. The ability to conduct prescribe fire within floodplain, marsh, and shrub bog communities with minimal damage to the natural community will greatly benefit a variety of species including the federally-threatened black rail as well as several state-threatened birds including little blue heron, roseate spoonbill, tricolored heron, and wood stork. This machine will also be used to restore critical habiat in empheral ponds for the reticulated flatwoods salamader, a federally listed species. A thorough search of tracked amphibious vehicles was conducted to identify comparable equipment with none being found that have the same capabilities and implement options provided by Marsh Master. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services (FDACS) Title: MowerMax Equipment Co. Agency number: SS 26 27 69 Commodity codes: 21101701 Mowers; 21102200 Forestry machinery and equipment Posting:

THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR A BID OR PROPOSAL 

 

This notice is provided in accordance with statutory requirements for a 15-business-day advertisement of the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services’ intent to enter into a single source agreement.

 

The Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services intends to enter into an agreement with MowerMax Equipment Co. to procure MowerMax Boom Mower Gen 4. 

 

Prospective Vendors who believe they can provide these commodities, or contractual services shall provide relevant information to the contact person listed on this advertisement no later than October 2, 2026. 

 

For additional details regarding the commodities and/or contractual services to be procured, please refer to the attached PUR 7776.

Short Description: MowerMax Boom Mower Gen 4 Quantity: Date of Execution - June 30, 2027 Requestor: Florida Forest Service Requirements: The Florida Forest Service intends to purchase one (1) MowerMax Boom Mower Gen 4 for use in forestry operations, primarily for wildfire mitigation and fuel reduction to protect life, property, and structures. This equipment will help ensure the Florida Forest Service can continue fulfilling the duties outlined in Florida Statute 589.04, which directs the agency to cooperate with federal, state, and local governments, nonprofit organizations, and others to promote and encourage forest fire protection, forest environmental education, forest land stewardship, responsible forest management, tree planting and care, forest recreation, and the proper management of public lands. ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: Approximate Contract Amount: $325,253.05 Approximate Amount up to: $350,000.00 Justification: MowerMax Equipment Co. are the only Manufacture of the MowerMax Boom Mower Gen 4. The MowerMax Boom Mower Gen is the only Heavy-Duty Boom Mower that will withstand the stresses and abuse of being used in roadside and limited access areas to reduce vegetation and overgrown locations. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Health (DOH) Title: IDEXX Agency number: EXP2691 Commodity codes: 41104000 Sampling equipment Posting:

The Florida Department of Health (FDOH), Osceola County has a need to purchase a fully automated desktop microbiological testing water testing system that is US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) approved, including supplies, service plan, training, and installation services. The system will be accredited by the Bureau of Public Health Laboratories to perform microbiological testing on potable and non-potable water. Section 381.006 Florida Statutes mandates that Environmental Health’s program consists of a drinking water function and support determinations by the State Health Officer of safe levels of contaminants in water.

The system will be accredited by the Bureau of Public Health Laboratories to perform microbiological testing on potable and non-potable water. Notice of intended single-source purchase, Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services (FDACS) Title: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. Agency number: SS 26 27 65 Commodity codes: 41106300 Polymerase chain reaction PCR and reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction RT PCR products; 41115800 Clinical and diagnostic analyzers and accessories and supplies Posting:

THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR A BID OR PROPOSAL 

This notice is provided in accordance with statutory requirements for a 15-business-day advertisement of the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services intent to enter into a single source agreement.

The Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services intends to enter into an agreement with Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. to procure Laboratory and scientific equipment; Laboratory supplies and fixtures & Software.

Prospective Vendors who believe they can provide these commodities, or contractual services shall provide relevant information to the contact person listed on this advertisement no later than October 09, 2026. 

For additional details regarding the commodities and/or contractual services to be procured, please refer to the attached PUR 7776.

Short Description: Laboratory and scientific equipment; Laboratory supplies and fixtures & Software Quantity: Date of Execution - June 30, 2027 Requestor: Division of Plant Industry Requirements: The Division of Plant Industry intends to purchase one Bio-Rad QX700E Droplet Digital PCR System, including the instrument, QX700 ddPCR System Analysis Software, and QX700 ddPCR System Control Software. The system enables and automates seven color multiplexing for up to 48 samples per run and provides clear discrimination of multiple targets. The purchase also includes associated consumables and accessories. Intended Single Source: ______________________________________________________________________________ Amount: Approximate Contract Amount: $56,829.02 Approximate Contract Amount up to: $60,000.00 Justification: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. is the original manufacturer and sole supplier of the QX700E Droplet Digital PCR System, and no other vendor produces or distributes this instrument or its proprietary components. The technology relies on patented microfluidic emulsion partitioning and integrated consumables that are exclusively developed and commercialized by Bio-Rad. The Methods Development and Biological Control program requires this specific system because it supports high resolution, seven color multiplex ddPCR applications essential for environmental DNA (eDNA) detection of pests without requiring the physical presence of the organism, and provides enhanced resolution and reliability with reduced hands on maintenance. No alternative supplier can provide an equivalent system or compatible components.
